_about: Unlock tree (Fragments). cost 0 = open from the start. grants = keys written to SaveV3.unlocks; exploits = exploit ids a pool node opens for Campaign / Quick drafts and markets; starter = the exploit a run starts holding when this node is the equipped starter. tag = the card's one-line label when the node has neither exploits nor a starter. col/row place the card; by = hour of play by which a median player can afford it (docs/BALANCE.md, Unlock economy); when = the cadence label shown on the card.

nodes.name: STARTER SET
nodes.desc: The first 8 exploits. Open from the start.

nodes.name: EXPLOITS II
nodes.desc: +8 exploits. The PHANTOM line arrives: decoys and misdirection.

nodes.name: EXPLOITS III
nodes.desc: +8 exploits. More GHOST chains, REDLINE heat and TRACER tools.

nodes.name: EXPLOITS IV
nodes.desc: +8 exploits. Cold Boot, Overvolt, Shadow Copy and the rest of the Common and Rare tail.

nodes.name: EXPLOITS V
nodes.desc: +8 exploits. Rare build-arounds and the first Epics.

nodes.name: EXPLOITS VI
nodes.desc: The last 8 exploits: Epics that change how a run plays.

nodes.name: DUOS
nodes.desc: Duo exploits can be offered once you hold both parent archetypes.

nodes.name: GHOST START
nodes.desc: Campaign and Quick runs start holding Clean Handshake. One starter at a time: equip it here.

nodes.name: PHANTOM START
nodes.desc: Campaign and Quick runs start holding Ghost Ping. One starter at a time: equip it here.

nodes.name: REDLINE START
nodes.desc: Campaign and Quick runs start holding Brinkmanship. One starter at a time: equip it here.

nodes.name: OVERCLOCK START
nodes.desc: Campaign and Quick runs start holding Coolant Leak. One starter at a time: equip it here.

nodes.name: TRACER START
nodes.desc: Campaign and Quick runs start holding Log Wipe. One starter at a time: equip it here.

nodes.name: DAILY BREACH
nodes.desc: One shared seed a day. Visible from the start.

nodes.name: BLACK MARKET
nodes.desc: Black Market nodes appear on the run map: spend Cycles on exploits, removals and Backups. Until then they play as Infiltration rooms.

nodes.name: TIME-ATTACK
nodes.desc: Fixed-seed rooms with Bronze, Silver, Gold and SYNC medals, and ghost replays.
